categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: Industrial Cleaning Systems and Surface Treatment, and Intelligent Equipment Manufacturing. The Industrial Cleaning segment includes general multi-piece cleaning, specialized single-piece cleaning, and precision cleaning, serving industries such as automotive (including new energy vehicles), machinery electronics, and medical. The Intelligent Equipment segment covers rubber intelligent equipment, digital factories, and electrical automation and integration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced cleaning technologies including water-based cleaning, solvent cleaning, high-pressure cleaning, ultrasonic cleaning, pulse pressure cleaning, and plasma technology. It integrates automation and robotics, CNC technology, and digital factory solutions. The rubber intelligent equipment segment employs technologies like robotic automation, servo drives, and digital control systems, with a focus on high-precision tire forming machines and intelligent logistics systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global automotive manufacturers (including new energy vehicle producers), machinery electronics firms, medical device companies, and general industrial manufacturers. The company serves high-automation, high-cleanliness, and complex process industries. Geographically, customers are located in Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific, with a strong presence in China, Germany, the USA, and other industrialized regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with production bases, R&D centers, sales, and service centers in China, Germany, France, Switzerland, the USA, India, Mexico, and the Czech Republic. Its markets span Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific, with significant revenue generated from overseas operations (over 90%).
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the industrial automation and cleaning equipment supply chain. It designs, manufactures, and sells industrial cleaning systems, surface treatment equipment, and intelligent manufacturing equipment, providing integrated solutions and services to OEMs and industrial manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in cleaning technologies, automation, and intelligent manufacturing. The company invests heavily in R&D centers globally, focusing on high-purity and precision cleaning, new energy vehicle battery cleaning, digital factory integration, and rubber intelligent equipment. It pursues modular product design, digitalization, and sustainability, aiming to enhance product competitiveness and expand into new markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of industrial cleaning systems, surface treatment equipment, and intelligent manufacturing machinery. The company also earns income from customized engineering services, after-sales services, and technology solutions. It operates mainly on a direct sales model with some authorized agents, focusing on long-term contracts and customer relationships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a global leader and one of the few with a comprehensive international presence in industrial cleaning and intelligent equipment manufacturing. It competes with other high-end equipment manufacturers in the automation and cleaning sectors, leveraging its advanced technology, global footprint, and strong brand portfolio including Ecoclean. It emphasizes its unique global integration and technical innovation to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.36 billion, with a slight decline of 5.5% year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 21.76 million, showing a modest increase in losses compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 1.88 billion, with a net asset value of RMB 853 million. Despite current losses, cash flow from operations improved significantly, indicating a recovery trajectory supported by global market expansion and R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its technology-driven approach, offering high-performance, high-quality, and high-precision cleaning and intelligent manufacturing solutions. Its products are modular, customizable, and integrate advanced automation and digital technologies, enabling customers to achieve higher cleaning quality, process stability, and cost savings. The global presence and strong brand portfolio provide customers with reliable, localized support and innovative solutions tailored to diverse industrial needs.
